The article claims that with the advent of quantum internet, virtual private networks will no longer provide anonymity, as quantum-level tracing can reveal users’ locations. It argues that the enhanced precision of quantum communication would allow network operators to identify where traffic originates, undermining the privacy guarantees of current VPN technology. The piece is presented as aggregated news coverage and is not a technical research study.
